$comment: HAND-EDITED per-row facts of the settings schema that are not a row's own definition. kept_on_reset_all: keys Reset All Settings leaves alone, the look picked at onboarding (the app theme and the terminal font), which each row still resets (SettingsController.resetAllSettings). shared_with_browser: cmux-next keys cmux-browser reads too (cmux-browser #567 moved its copies to cmux.json); their consumers are cmux-next and cmux-browser (rows moved to schemas/settings/source say so themselves, in their consumers). validation: how another validator checks a row's value: portable (the export's fixed rule and samples), or domain:<name> when only the app knows the valid values (theme names, installed fonts, system sounds) or the value has its own shape; keys wins over kinds. scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift copy (SettingsSchema+RowFacts.generated.swift); the schema export writes kept_on_reset_all, consumers and validation per row from it. former_defaults: each key's earlier defaults that held for a day or more (from the history of schemas/defaults/cmux-next.json, 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-08); the one-time launch migration SettingsController.forgetStoredDefaults drops a stored value equal to one of them or to the current default, so the key follows the default again (Leo 2026-11-08). Since then a write of the default removes the key (setSetting), so a later default change needs no entry here. updates.downloadAutomatically has no entry: off from Leo 2026-10-27, a stored true was the person's pick, and dropping it turned their automatic updates off (Lawrence 2026-11-08); on by default again since Leo 2026-11-07, a stored false is the person's pick.
